Voices

Choose a language, then choose a voice.

Eloqium currently provides eight regional language variants. Each variant includes the same set of eight voice presets.

Voice presets

Eight names are available in every region.

Choose a preset under Settings → Voice → Voice profile.

  1. Reed
  2. Shelley
  3. Bobby
  4. Rocko
  5. Glen
  6. Sandy
  7. Grandma
  8. Grandpa

Using the voices

Choose the language in Eloqium, then select the voice profile.

Android TTS clients can also request supported language variants through the standard TTS interface.
